firmware.notes: Recovers invalid factory MAC using a per-device locally administered base MAC saved in NVS before Wi-Fi starts. Reuses the saved MAC across reboot and future compatible OTA updates; healthy factory MACs remain unchanged. No eFuse writes. Connection details show the active Station MAC and its source.

ascomDriver.notes: Hold Shift while clicking Firmware Update to select a local Flat Panel OTA payload. Normal clicks keep online updates. Local mode works offline and rejects merged images and incompatible ESP32 chip images.
